card.name: Capitalized DO before NOT warnings
card.fires_on: The word DO (or do) starting an emphatic prohibition, right after an instruction sentence, as in "DO NOT shake". Also fires on IMPORTANT used as a warning label.

modes.label: DO NOT after handling steps
modes.description: DO starts a prohibition after a swirl, mix or reconstitution instruction.
modes.example: Gently swirl the vial continuously until the powder is completely dissolved.<< DO>> NOT shake.

modes.label: IMPORTANT as warning label
modes.description: IMPORTANT introduces a emphasized instruction in device directions.
modes.example: Instructions for Administration of Bosaya Prefilled Syringe with Needle Safety Guard<< IMPORTANT>>: The preﬁlled syringe

modes.label: Lowercase do in parentheses
modes.description: A lowercase do not appears in a non-drug how-to aside.
modes.example: (<<do>> not use honey) to four parts boiling

card.writes: It promotes words meaning must and important, pushing emphatic requirement wording.
card.plain: It marks the start of a capitalized "DO NOT" warning in preparation or handling instructions.
